'''Senntisten Teleport''' requires a [[Magic]] level of 60 to cast. It [[teleport]]s the caster to the [[Digsite]] [[exam centre]]. The teleport is also close to the [[South-east Varrock mine]] and [[Al Kharid mine]].

As with all [[Ancient Magicks]] spells, the quest [[Desert Treasure I]] must be completed to cast this spell.
